value.rationale: The network size required for the failure of peak-overload risk monotonicity under adding one contact is a natural structural cutoff. A minimum-six counterexample combined with a complete all-rate classification below it clarifies why final-outbreak reach and pathwise concurrent load can have distinct edge responses; the small witness magnitude does not nullify the sharp size boundary. This is an exact network-risk fact, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
